title: Home page loads with six modules
expected: Page shows the six module cards and live travel updates
actual: 6 module cards shown; travel updates panel shown

title: Generate a 3-day Smart Itinerary
steps: Open Smart Itinerary, keep defaults (3 days, 2 adults, Foreign Non-Resident), click Generate
expected: A timed plan for Day 1–3 with a total cost is shown

title: Itinerary includes Paraa ferry for North Bank activities
steps: Inspect the generated plan from TC02
expected: A “Paraa ferry” item appears before the North Bank game drive
actual: ferry item present; game drive present

title: Budget uses UGX tariffs for East African Citizens
steps: Open Budget, choose East African Citizen
expected: Park entry shown as UGX 25,000 per adult per day and total in UGX

title: Budget uses USD tariffs for Foreign Non-Residents
expected: Park entry calculated from US$45 per adult per day
actual: Entry line shows @ US$45 converted to UGX

title: Route distance and travel time
steps: Open Navigation; route Kichumbanyobo Gate → Paraa Jetty; click Distance & travel time
